function.name: login_user
function.description: Logs in the user to authenticate the user to access their account. The identification used can either be a password or a driver's license. Returns true or false for login success or failure.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

anyOf.description: the driver's license of the user

drivers_license_id.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

drivers_license_state.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

function.name: logout_user
function.description: Logs out the user by forgetting all user-said information. Returns true always because of successful logout.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: open_account
function.description: Creates and opens an account with a specified username and identification, which could be a password or driver's license. Returns true or false for successful account creation.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

anyOf.description: the driver's license of the user

drivers_license_id.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

drivers_license_state.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

admin_password.description: The admin password of the user's account to access additional functionalities in their account.

function.name: authenticate_admin_password
function.description: Verifies that the entered admin password is correct for this account. Enables more functionality. Returns true or false for admin password verification.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

admin_password.description: The admin password of the user's account to access additional functionalities in their account.

function.name: set_admin_password
function.description: Sets the admin password for their account. Returns true or false for successful admin password reset.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

admin_password_new.description: The new admin password of the user's account that the user set.

function.name: set_account_information
function.description: Sets the information for their account. Returns true or false for successful account information reset.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

username_new.description: The new username of the user's account.

anyOf.description: the new password to their account
the new driver's license of the user

drivers_license_id.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

drivers_license_state.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

function.name: close_account
function.description: Closes the account and deletes all information in this account from the database. Returns true or false for successful account closing.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: get_account_balance
function.description: Retrieves the bank account balance of the user's account. Returns the float account balance or false if retrieval conditions are not met.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: transfer_funds
function.description: Transfers the funds from the current user's account balance to the destination account balance of another user. Returns true or false for the successful transfer of funds

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

destination_username.description: the username of the destination account

amount.description: the amount of funds specified by the function description

unit.description: the unit of money dollar, cent, dollars, or cents

function.name: deposit_funds
function.description: Deposits the amount of funds listed into the account. Returns true or false on if the funds were successfully deposited.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

amount.description: the amount of funds specified by the function description

unit.description: the unit of money dollar, cent, dollars, or cents

anyOf.description: a string description of what form the deposit is used, usually cash

check_name.description: the owner name of the account the check is written from

check_routing_number.description: the routing number of the account the check is made out from

function.name: pay_bill
function.description: Pays a bill from an account. This amount of money will be deducted from the account. Returns true or false on if payment was successful.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

amount.description: the amount of funds specified by the function description

unit.description: the unit of money dollar, cent, dollars, or cents

bill_description.description: The description of the what bill is being paid.

function.name: pay_bill_with_credit_card
function.description: Pays a bill from an account. This amount of money will be added to the credit card balance of the credit card used. Returns true or false on if payment was successful.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

amount.description: the amount of funds specified by the function description

card_number.description: the card number of a specific card in the database

function.name: apply_credit_card
function.description: The user applies for a credit card based on some information.  Returns  true or false for successful application of a credit card.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

total_assets.description: The applicant's total assets. This determines the eligibility for the credit card

monthly_income.description: The applicant's monthly income. This determines the spending limit for this credit card.

function.name: exchange_foreign_currency
function.description: Exchanges some USD for some specified foreign currency. Returns the float account of foreign currency exchanged.

amount.description: the amount of funds specified by the function description

unit.description: the unit of money dollar, cent, dollars, or cents

foreign_currency_type.description: The foreign currency type the customer wants to change to.

function.name: get_account_owed_balance
function.description: Retrieves the bank account owed balance of the user's account. Returns the float account owed balance or false if retrieval conditions are not met.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: get_loan
function.description: The user applies for a loan. Returns true or false for the successful application of a loan amount.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

loan_amount.description: Amount of money the user wants to loan.

function.name: pay_loan
function.description: The user pays off a portion or the entire loan off with their account balance. The user pays exactly the requested amount. Returns true or false for the successful payment of the loan at the amount specified.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

pay_owed_amount_request.description: Amount of money the user wants use to pay off their loan, owed balance.

function.name: get_safety_box
function.description: Gets the contents of the safety box. Returns the contents of the safety box or false if retrieval conditions are not met.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: set_safety_box
function.description: Sets the contents of the safety box. Returns true or false for successful safety box reset.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

safety_box_new.description: the new contents of the safety box

function.name: get_credit_cards
function.description: Gets a list of the credit cards a user has along with the information. Returns a list of credit cards the user has.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: get_credit_card_info
function.description: Gets the information of a specific credit card.This includes credit limit and credit balance on the card. Returns a dictionary of information of a credit card, including credit limit and credit balance.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

card_number.description: the card number of a specific card in the database

function.name: cancel_credit_card
function.description: Cancels a credit card that a user has. Returns true or false based on successful deletion of a credit card

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

card_number.description: the card number of a specific card in the database

function.name: get_bank_maximum_loan_amount
function.description: Shows the maximum amount of money the bank can loan to any individual at this moment. The maximum is half of the total amount of cash at the bank given in bank_total_cash. If bank_total_cash is not given, it is 0. Returns the maximum amount of money the bank can loan at this moment.

bank_total_cash.description: the total amount of cash at the bank

function.name: internal_check_username_exist
function.description: Returns true or false if some username does exist within the database. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true if the inputted username of the account does exist in the database.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: internal_check_foreign_currency_available
function.description: Returns true or false if the foreign currency type is available at this bank. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true if the foreign currency type is available at this bank.

foreign_currency_type.description: The foreign currency type the customer wants to change to.

function.name: internal_get_credit_score
function.description: Gets the credit score of a user. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns the credit score of the user.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

function.name: internal_check_credit_card_exist
function.description: Returns true or false if some credit card does exist within the database for a user. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true or false if the inputted credit card does exist under a user.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

card_number.description: the card number of a specific card in the database
